name: io.github.askeleven/do-not-contact
title: Do Not Contact
description: One opt-out list across email, SMS and calls. Stores keyed hashes, never addresses.

packageArguments.name: --list
packageArguments.description: Path to the JSONL list file

environmentVariables.name: DNC_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret used to key the stored hashes

environmentVariables.name: DNC_DEFAULT_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Default country calling code for phone numbers, such as 1
